title: 2 Swing Arm Towel Rail - 12.5-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass - Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels within reach without crowding your vanity—this swing arm towel rail folds neatly against the wall when you’re done. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty, it’s crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday bathroom use.

  • Save space in smaller baths with two independently swiveling arms that tuck close to the wall
  • Reduce countertop clutter by adding flexible, wall-mounted towel storage right where you need it
  • Get a clean, finished look with concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Choose a coordinated look—part of the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place transitional bath accessories
